item.title: Hear a market stall briefing
item.summary: A market helper explains how to set up and close a stall.
item.transcript_text: Welcome, helpers. Before you open a box of food, check the number on the table. Bread is table five, and cakes are table six. Put the price cards in front so visitors can read them. At noon, bring back any full boxes. Do not pack the food we are still selling. After we close at one, wipe the table and leave the cash box with Ella in the main tent.

options: Picking a table as a visitor
questions.explanation: Helpers receive setup, stock and close-down instructions.
The first instruction is to find the assigned table.

options: At the front of the table
questions.explanation: Cards go where customers can read them.
The speaker distinguishes full boxes from items still on sale.

questions.prompt: Who takes the cash box at the end?
questions.explanation: The cash box goes to Ella.
